facts.note: North to south: the town at the north end, the flat, the black water, the body at the south end, and the Run behind its tail.
East to west across the whole region, the open sea west of the black water included: what stands in the sea out there is inside the map, so the fog painted over that water is inside it too.
The coach road at the top of the cliff (DESIGN.md: y 96).
The harbour quay. DESIGN.md gives the harbour at y 66; the quay stands at 72 so the emptied basin lies a stair below it on the mud at 64.
The walk plane of the mud: mud at y 62-63 over the sea at y 62 (DESIGN.md).
The top of the head, forty blocks over the flat (DESIGN.md: the Crown).
The black water is about sixty blocks wide; the two ferry houses' centres stand at least that far apart.
The Narrows ridge: three blocks in DESIGN.md, drawn at the kit grid's four.
The Rib Cathedral's vault, about forty blocks in DESIGN.md, held under the back the Crown stands on.

The body from the mouth to the end of the tail flank. DESIGN.md gives about 140; the open-air descent from the back to the bank is built as four broad steps of eight (see GENERATION.md), which lengthens the tail.
The body from the bank to the back (DESIGN.md: about 45, the forehead at about y 108).
The flat from the foot of the slipway stair to the black water (DESIGN.md: about 320).
